questions.question: What is total internal reflection? State two conditions for it to occur.
questions.solution:
**Total internal reflection:** When light traveling from denser to rarer medium is reflected back into the denser medium at angles greater than critical angle.

**Conditions:**
1. Light must travel from denser to rarer medium (n₁ > n₂)
2. Angle of incidence > critical angle (i > i_c)
questions.knowledgeNote: Critical angle: sin(i_c) = n₂/n₁. For water-air: i_c = 48.6°. Fiber optics uses TIR.
